# Associated Dental

> Multi-location dental care and orthodontics provider serving Phoenix, Tucson, Scottsdale, Glendale, and Chandler with family dentistry and comprehensive oral health services.

Associated Dental operates multiple locations across Arizona, offering general dentistry, orthodontics, and specialized dental care. The practice serves communities in the Phoenix metropolitan area and Tucson region with a focus on family-friendly dental services and insurance coordination.
